standard.summary: 防止纯 PyTorch O(n²) fallback 在长序列误跑。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Stops the pure PyTorch O(n^2) fallback from running by mistake on a long sequence.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 防止纯 PyTorch O(n²) fallback 在长序列误跑。仅 torch_fallback 生效。

advanced_en.principle: Prevents the pure-PyTorch O(n²) fallback from accidentally running on long sequences. Only effective for torch_fallback.
